sample_orders_plausible: sample plausible orders for each power in a Diplomacy game using base strategy or ParlAI models
renormalize_policy: renormalize a policy dictionary so that probabilities for each power sum to one
cutoff_policy: cutoff a policy to keep only the top N most probable orders per power
rescore_actions_parlai: rescore candidate actions using a ParlAI model to update their probabilities based on dialogue context
are_supports_coordinated: check if support and convoy orders in an action are properly coordinated without contradictions
